title: A SunPy Project Update
text:
Breaking Changes and Removals


Breaking * Increased minimum versions: Python >= 3.12, astropy >= 6.1.0, matplotlib >= 3.8.0, numpy >= 1.26.0, pandas >= 2.2.0, scipy >= 1.12.0

Removals * Removed backwards compatibility with the legacy keyword, pattern within sunpy.net.Scraper * Remove deprecated assume_spherical_screen method in favor of SphericalScreen
